overview.about: The European Rugby Champions Cup final is the showpiece of top-tier European club rugby union, pitting the continent's two best clubs against each other for the title. Toulouse are the competition's most successful club. The final is played at a neutral host stadium.
overview.nextEvent: The next European Rugby Champions Cup final is a single match at a neutral venue, this edition in Cardiff. The two finalists emerge from a season of pool and knockout rugby featuring the leading clubs of England, France, Ireland and beyond.
